en:
## New Features

- Shiki syntax highlighting for inline code in Pixi message renderer
- Word-level diff highlighting in edit tool cards for clearer change visualization
- Proper line-diff algorithm (replaces naive line-by-line comparison)
- SideCar abstraction for unified injected content management with dedicated DB persistence
- Decoupled yield output from model output — frontend receives raw tool results while model API gets sidecars
- Subagent metadata fields on Pixi message blocks for upcoming subagent UI

## Bug Fixes

- ExitPlanMode reflection now only triggers in bypassPermissions mode (no longer blocks normal permission flows)
- Handle standalone "error" events from OpenAI Responses API (previously silently dropped)
- Remove overly aggressive Write-overwrite YOLO safety check that interrupted common file operations
- Fix pagination auto-load getting stuck after prepending older messages
- Fix Edit tool card collapsing briefly during streaming
- Fix first-token timeout handling and Codex WebSocket recovery

## Improvements

- TODO reminders now use sidecar cadence (every 4 tool calls) instead of polluting every message
- YOLO safety pause messages are now internationalized
- Improved Pixi inline-code rendering in headings
- Better tool card vertical alignment
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- Pixi 消息渲染器中行内代码支持 Shiki 语法高亮
- 编辑工具卡片支持词级别 diff 高亮，变更一目了然
- 使用正规 diff 算法替代原来的逐行对比
- SideCar 抽象层统一管理注入内容，独立数据库持久化
- 前端接收原始工具输出，模型 API 侧独立附加 sidecar
- Pixi 消息块新增子代理元数据字段

## 修复

- ExitPlanMode 反射检查仅在 bypassPermissions 模式下触发，不再阻断正常权限流程
- 正确处理 OpenAI Responses API 的独立 error 事件（之前被静默丢弃）
- 移除过于激进的 Write 覆盖 YOLO 安全检查
- 修复向上加载历史消息后分页自动加载卡住的问题
- 修复 Edit 工具卡片在流式传输期间短暂折叠的闪烁
- 修复首 token 超时处理和 Codex WebSocket 恢复

## 改进

- TODO 提醒改为 sidecar 节奏（每 4 次工具调用），不再污染每条消息
- YOLO 安全暂停消息支持国际化
- 改进标题中行内代码的 Pixi 渲染
- 优化工具卡片垂直对齐
